+def project_delta(
+    builder: Any,
+    base_nodes: dict[str, Any],
+    base_edges: dict[str, Any],
+    procedures: dict[str, Any],
+    delta: dict[str, Any],
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    nodes = {node["node_id"]: deepcopy(node) for node in base_nodes["nodes"]}
+    edges = {
+        current["edge_id"]: deepcopy(current) for current in base_edges["edges"]
+    }
+
+    def add_node(node: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        require(node["node_id"] not in nodes, f"duplicate node: {node['node_id']}")
+        nodes[node["node_id"]] = node
+
+    def add_edge(current: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        require(
+            current["edge_id"] not in edges,
+            f"duplicate edge: {current['edge_id']}",
+        )
+        edges[current["edge_id"]] = current
+
+    add_node(
+        {
+            "label": "Differential Equations",
+            "node_id": TOPIC_ID,
+            "node_type": "Topic",
+            "status": "approved",
+            "topic_id": TOPIC_ID,
+        }
+    )
+    add_node(
+        {
+            "label": "Differential Equations",
+            "node_id": FAMILY_ID,
+            "node_type": "QuestionFamily",
+            "question_family_id": FAMILY_ID,
+            "status": "approved",
+        }
+    )
+    add_edge(builder.edge(TOPIC_ID, "CONTAINS", FAMILY_ID, "approved"))
+
+    for question_type in TYPE_DEFINITIONS:
+        type_id = question_type["question_type_id"]
+        add_node(
+            {
+                **deepcopy(question_type),
+                "node_id": type_id,
+                "node_type": "QuestionType",
+            }
+        )
+        add_edge(builder.edge(FAMILY_ID, "CONTAINS", type_id, "approved"))
+
+    model = next(
+        item
+        for item in procedures["procedure_models"]
+        if item["procedure_model_id"] == CORE_MODEL
+    )
+    add_node(
+        {
+            **deepcopy(model),
+            "node_id": CORE_MODEL,
+            "node_type": "ProcedureModel",
+        }
+    )
+    add_edge(builder.edge(SOLVE_TYPE, "USES_PROCEDURE", CORE_MODEL, "approved"))
+    for step in model["procedure_steps"]:
+        step_id = step["procedure_step_id"]
+        add_node(
+            {
+                **deepcopy(step),
+                "node_id": step_id,
+                "node_type": "ProcedureStep",
+                "procedure_model_id": CORE_MODEL,
+            }
+        )
+        add_edge(builder.edge(CORE_MODEL, "HAS_STEP", step_id, "approved"))
+
+    for record in delta["question_records"]:
+        for binding in record["classification_bindings"]:
+            current = builder.edge(
+                binding["question_part_id"],
+                "PART_CLASSIFIED_AS",
+                binding["question_type_id"],
+                "approved",
+            )
+            current["classification_role"] = binding["classification_role"]
+            current["part_ownership_decision_ref"] = binding["decision_id"]
+            add_edge(current)
+
+    for instance in delta["procedure_instances"]:
+        instance_id = instance["procedure_instance_id"]
+        add_node(
+            {
+                **deepcopy(instance),
+                "node_id": instance_id,
+                "node_type": "ProcedureInstance",
+            }
+        )
+        add_edge(
+            builder.edge(
+                instance["question_part_id"],
+                "HAS_PROCEDURE_INSTANCE",
+                instance_id,
+                instance["status"],
+            )
+        )
+        add_edge(
+            builder.edge(
+                instance_id,
+                "INSTANCE_OF",
+                instance["procedure_model_ref"],
+                instance["status"],
+            )
+        )
+        for anchor_id in [
+            *instance["qp_evidence_anchor_refs"],
+            *instance["ms_evidence_anchor_refs"],
+        ]:
+            add_edge(
+                builder.edge(
+                    instance_id,
+                    "SUPPORTED_BY",
+                    anchor_id,
+                    instance["status"],
+                )
+            )
+
+    type_order = {
+        "Question": 0,
+        "QuestionPart": 1,
+        "EvidenceAnchor": 2,
+        "Topic": 3,
+        "QuestionFamily": 4,
+        "QuestionType": 5,
+        "ProcedureModel": 6,
+        "ProcedureStep": 7,
+        "ProcedureInstance": 8,
+        "ProcedureStepInstance": 9,
+    }
+    return (
+        {
+            **base_nodes,
+            "issue": ISSUE,
+            "nodes": sorted(
+                nodes.values(),
+                key=lambda node: (type_order[node["node_type"]], node["node_id"]),
+            ),
+        },
+        {
+            **base_edges,
+            "issue": ISSUE,
+            "edges": sorted(edges.values(), key=lambda item: item["edge_id"]),
+        },
+    )

+def validate_release(
+    base_nodes_document: dict[str, Any],
+    base_edges_document: dict[str, Any],
+    nodes_document: dict[str, Any],
+    edges_document: dict[str, Any],
+    predecessor_registry: dict[str, Any],
+    predecessor_composition: dict[str, Any],
+    registry: dict[str, Any],
+    procedures: dict[str, Any],
+    composition: dict[str, Any],
+    decisions: dict[str, Any],
+    delta: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    nodes = nodes_document["nodes"]
+    edges = edges_document["edges"]
+    node_index = {node["node_id"]: node for node in nodes}
+    require(len(node_index) == len(nodes), "duplicate active identity")
+    require(
+        len({current["edge_id"] for current in edges}) == len(edges),
+        "duplicate active edge",
+    )
+    dangling = sum(
+        current["from_node_id"] not in node_index
+        or current["to_node_id"] not in node_index
+        for current in edges
+    )
+    unsupported = sum(current.get("inferred") is not False for current in edges)
+    require(dangling == 0, "dangling edge")
+    require(unsupported == 0, "unsupported inferred edge")
+    base_node_index = {
+        node["node_id"]: node for node in base_nodes_document["nodes"]
+    }
+    base_edge_index = {
+        current["edge_id"]: current
+        for current in base_edges_document["edges"]
+    }
+    current_edge_index = {
+        current["edge_id"]: current for current in edges
+    }
+    require(
+        all(node_index[key] == value for key, value in base_node_index.items())
+        and all(
+            current_edge_index[key] == value
+            for key, value in base_edge_index.items()
+        ),
+        "P3-00 graph or structural authority changed",
+    )
+    predecessor_by_id = {
+        item["question_id"]: item for item in predecessor_registry["records"]
+    }
+    current_by_id = {item["question_id"]: item for item in registry["records"]}
+    require(
+        all(current_by_id[key] == value for key, value in predecessor_by_id.items()),
+        "P3-00 semantic record changed",
+    )
+    predecessor_instances = {
+        item["procedure_instance_id"]: item
+        for item in predecessor_composition["procedure_instances"]
+    }
+    current_instances = {
+        item["procedure_instance_id"]: item
+        for item in composition["procedure_instances"]
+    }
+    require(
+        all(
+            current_instances[key] == value
+            for key, value in predecessor_instances.items()
+        ),
+        "P3-00 ProcedureInstance changed",
+    )
+
+    approved_without_evidence = sum(
+        item["status"] == "approved"
+        and (
+            not item["question_part_id"]
+            or not item["qp_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+            or not item["ms_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+        )
+        for item in composition["procedure_instances"]
+    )
+    candidate_instance_ids = {
+        item["procedure_instance_id"]
+        for item in composition["procedure_instances"]
+        if item["status"] == "candidate"
+    }
+    candidate_as_approved = sum(
+        current["edge_type"] in {"HAS_PROCEDURE_INSTANCE", "INSTANCE_OF"}
+        and current["status"] == "approved"
+        and (
+            current["from_node_id"] in candidate_instance_ids
+            or current["to_node_id"] in candidate_instance_ids
+        )
+        for current in edges
+    )
+    de_part_ids = {
+        item["question_part_id"] for item in decisions["decisions"]
+    }
+    primary_edges = [
+        current
+        for current in edges
+        if current["edge_type"] == "PART_CLASSIFIED_AS"
+        and current["from_node_id"] in de_part_ids
+        and current["status"] == "approved"
+    ]
+    primary_by_part: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for current in primary_edges:
+        primary_by_part[current["from_node_id"]].append(current)
+    primary_conflicts = sum(
+        len(current) != 1
+        or current[0].get("classification_role") != "primary"
+        for current in primary_by_part.values()
+    )
+    cross_family_conflicts = sum(
+        len(
+            {
+                node_index[current["to_node_id"]]["question_family_id"]
+                for current in values
+            }
+        )
+        > 1
+        for values in primary_by_part.values()
+    )
+    require(approved_without_evidence == 0, "approved instance lacks evidence")
+    require(candidate_as_approved == 0, "candidate exposed as approved")
+    require(primary_conflicts == 0, "primary classification cardinality conflict")
+    require(cross_family_conflicts == 0, "cross-Family primary ownership conflict")
+    require(
+        len(decisions["decisions"]) == EXPECTED_SCORE_OWNING_PARTS
+        and all(
+            item["review_status"] == "reviewed_terminal"
+            and item["exact_part_evidence_refs"]["qp_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+            and item["exact_part_evidence_refs"]["ms_evidence_anchor_refs"]
+            for item in decisions["decisions"]
+        ),
+        "QuestionPart terminal evidence review incomplete",
+    )
+    require(
+        len(delta["question_records"]) == EXPECTED_VERIFIED_QUESTIONS,
+        "Question scope conservation failed",
+    )
+    require(
+        len(procedures["procedure_models"]) == 6,
+        "shared ProcedureModel library drift",
+    )
+    return {
+        "approved_procedure_instance_without_exact_part_evidence_count": (
+            approved_without_evidence
+        ),
+        "candidate_exposed_as_approved_count": candidate_as_approved,
+        "candidate_procedure_instance_exposed_as_approved_count": (
+            candidate_as_approved
+        ),
+        "cross_family_primary_ownership_conflict_count": cross_family_conflicts,
+        "dangling_edge_count": dangling,
+        "deterministic_rebuild": "PASS",
+        "duplicate_active_identity_count": 0,
+        "duplicate_cross_family_procedure_model_count": 0,
+        "exact_question_part_qp_ms_evidence_readback": "PASS",
+        "incidental_operation_promoted_to_procedure_model_count": 0,
+        "primary_classification_role_cardinality_violation_count": (
+            primary_conflicts

+        "product_readback": "PASS",
+        "product_readback_pass_rate": 1.0,
+        "provider_call_count": 0,
+        "remote_write_count": 0,
+        "safe_rejection_input_count": 0,
+        "stale_authority_reference_count": 0,
+        "structural_authority_write_count": 0,
+        "unsupported_inferred_edge_count": unsupported,

+def extend_registry(

+    decisions: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:

+        "rejected_question_count": predecessor["summary"]["rejected_question_count"],
+        "whole_question_semantic_rollup_count": 0,

+def extend_composition(

+    composition["procedure_instances"].sort(

+    )
+    composition["issue"] = ISSUE
+    counts = Counter(

+    composition["summary"] = {
+        **predecessor["summary"],
+        "alternative_branch_count": 0,
+        "approved_procedure_instance_count": sum(
+            item["status"] == "approved"
+            for item in composition["procedure_instances"]
+        ),
+        "candidate_procedure_instance_count": sum(
+            item["status"] == "candidate"
+            for item in composition["procedure_instances"]
+        ),
+        "core_procedure_instance_count": sum(

+            for item in composition["procedure_instances"]

+        "procedure_instance_count": len(composition["procedure_instances"]),
+        "supporting_procedure_instance_count": sum(
+            item["role"] == "supporting"

+        ),
+        "differential_equations_core_procedure_instance_count": delta["summary"][

+        ],
+        "differential_equations_supporting_candidate_count": delta["summary"][
+            "supporting_procedure_instance_count"
+        ],

+    )
+    return composition

+def project_delta(

+
+    model = next(
